This '''Unidentified individual''' served as the [[Director/Legends|director]] of the [[Surgical Nursing Services]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="MedStar II" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the director ordered [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] [[Tolk le Trene]] to undergo a six [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] course about decubitus care.<ref name="MedStar II" />
